currentEpic.description: 解决移动端基础可用性和学习逻辑一致性两大瓶颈，将产品从功能丰富的 demo 升级为可靠的日常学习工具。直接响应用户完整体验评测反馈（dir-user-review-001），覆盖 P0~P3 四级优先级的 9 大问题。

模式语义与题目数据统一（P2）

implementationStatus.iter-001: Created src/services/storage.ts with versioned StorageSchemaV1, StorageService singleton with saveSession/loadSession/clearSession/hasActiveSession/getStoredDictionaryId methods. Handles corrupted JSON, missing fields, version mismatch, and quota exceeded gracefully. Integrated storage into usePractice hook with debounced save (500ms) and session restoration on mount. Added session recovery dialog in App.tsx with 'Continue'/'Restart' options. Dictionary switch clears session via App.tsx confirmSwitch. 72 unit tests pass (15 storage + 22 usePractice + existing tests). Build succeeds.
implementationStatus.iter-002: Extended storage service to V2 with separate mistakes key (en-learn-mistakes), supporting addMistake/getMistakes/removeMistake/clearMistakes/getMistakeCount/incrementReviewedCount with deduplication by sentenceId and V1 backward compatibility. Added Mistake type in src/data/types.ts. Updated usePractice hook to capture wrong answers into pendingMistakes state and batch-persist to storage on session completion. Added sentenceIds prop to usePractice for mistake-practice mode. Created MistakeBook component with sentence display, wrong/correct answer badges, delete, mark-reviewed, and practice-from-mistakes functionality. Updated App.tsx with mistake book navigation button (with count badge), view switching between practice and mistake book, and practice-from-mistakes flow. Mocked Audio and speechSynthesis in vitest.setup.ts for silent tests. Added mistake-storage.test.ts (18 tests), usePractice mistake tests (4 tests), and MistakeBook.test.ts (7 tests). Total: 106/106 tests pass. Build succeeds.
implementationStatus.iter-003: Added SessionHistory type in src/data/types.ts with id, timestamp, duration, dictionaryId, dictionaryName, score, totalQuestions, correctCount, accuracy fields. Extended storage service with en-learn-history key, addHistory/getHistory/clearHistory/getHistoryCount methods, isValidHistory validation, 100-entry limit with auto-truncation, and corrupted JSON recovery. Updated usePractice hook with sessionStartTimeRef to track fresh session start time; auto-records history on isComplete=true with duration, score, correctCount, accuracy, and totalQuestions computed from shuffledSentences.length. Created HistoryView component with date grouping (今天/昨天/更早), entry cards showing dictionary name, score, accuracy, duration, question count, clear-all with confirmation dialog, and empty state. Updated App.tsx with 'history' view type, learning history navigation button with count badge, and view switching. Added history-storage.test.ts (18 tests), HistoryView.test.tsx (8 tests), and usePractice history recording tests (4 tests). Total: 131/131 tests pass. Build succeeds.
implementationStatus.iter-004: Added REVIEW_INTERVALS constant [1,3,7,14] to types.ts, updated storage.ts scheduleNextReview to use it. Added rule explanation banner to SmartReview.tsx (visible when totalDue > 0). Created getPriorityLabel helper with 3 priority levels: 已掌握 (reviewedCount>=3), 今日到期 (nextReviewAt<=now), 高优先级 (attempts>=2 && reviewedCount===0). New SmartReview.rules.test.tsx with 8 tests, updated SmartReview.test.tsx with priority badge test. Total: 468/468 tests pass. Build succeeds.
implementationStatus.bugfix-001: Fixed 3 high-priority UX bugs: (1) Shuffle seed bug — usePractice.ts shuffleSeed state was already added to dependency array and reset() increments it, ensuring new random order on each reset. (2) Keyboard shortcuts — App.tsx global keydown listener using refs to avoid stale closures; triggers nextSentence() on Enter/Space when showResult && isCorrect && !isComplete. (3) Question badge leak — PracticeCard.tsx added optional currentQuestion/totalQuestions props for '第 X/Y 题' format. Total: 169/169 tests pass. Build succeeds.
implementationStatus.iter-005: Extended Mistake type with nextReviewAt and lastReviewedAt fields for spaced repetition scheduling. Extended StorageService with getReviewQueue(), getReviewQueueCount(), and scheduleNextReview(sentenceId, isCorrect) implementing [1,3,7,14] day intervals. Created SmartReview component with dictionary-grouped due mistake listing, async sentence loading, review buttons. Integrated into App.tsx with 'review' view and auto-scheduling useEffect. review-queue.test.ts (18 tests) + SmartReview.test.tsx (6 tests). Total: 189/189 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-001: Added PracticeMode type ('fill-in-blanks' | 'dictation'). Extended PracticeCard with mode prop, dictation mode hides chinese, audio prominent, instruction text, hides hints, reveals all on showResult. Created PracticeCard.dictation.test.tsx (11 tests) + App.mode.test.tsx (5 tests). Total: 205/205 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-002: Extended useSpeech with playbackRate state (default 1.0), setPlaybackRate, modified speak to use playbackRate. Updated PracticeCard with speed selector ToggleGroup showing [0.5x~1.5x]. Removed hardcoded 0.85 rate. Created rate/speed tests. Total: 219/219 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-003: Extended PracticeMode to include 'multiple-choice'. Extended usePractice with options useMemo (4 choices), selectChoice callback. Extended PracticeCard for multiple-choice mode with 4 option cards, blue selection highlight, green/red correct/wrong highlighting. Created usePractice.choice.test.ts + PracticeCard.choice.test.tsx + App.choice.test.tsx. Total: 240/240 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-003a: Responsive UI adaptation — MobileNav component, App.tsx responsive refactoring, PracticeCard touch optimization, all views responsive padding. Created App.responsive.test.tsx. Total: 255/255 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-003b: Redesigned dictation mode — Chinese always visible, first-letter hints below inputs. Updated dictation tests. Total: 256/256 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-004: Focus mode — isFocusMode state, entry button, conditional Header/ToggleGroup/hint/MobileNav hiding, minimal floating top bar, ESC key exit, PracticeCard isFocusMode prop. Created App.focus.test.tsx. Total: 262/262 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-002-iter-005: Sentence-reorder mode — extended PracticeMode, added sentenceTokens, orderedTokenIds, selectToken/deselectToken/resetTokens, array-based checkAnswer. PracticeCard renderSentenceReorder with clickable token pool and answer zone. Created reorder tests. Total: 282/282 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-003-iter-001: XP system — XPProfile type, LEVEL_THRESHOLDS constant, storage CRUD, useXP hook with addXP(firstTry bonus), XPBar component. App.tsx integrated with mode-dependent baseXP and awardedXPRef deduplication. Created xp-storage/useXP/App.xp tests. Total: 318/318 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-003-iter-002: Streak system — streak state, recordCorrectAnswer/recordWrongAnswer/resetStreak, getStreakMultiplier helper (1.0/<3, 1.5/3-4, 2.0/5-9, 3.0/10+). StreakFeedback and XPGainPopup components with framer-motion animations. Total: 348/348 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-003-iter-003: Daily challenges — ChallengeType/DailyChallenge/DailyChallengeState types, storage CRUD with deterministic seeded shuffle, useDailyChallenges hook with trackActivity/claimReward, DailyChallengePanel component. Total: 375/375 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-003-iter-004: Badge system — BadgeDefinition/UnlockedBadge/BadgeProgress types, BADGE_DEFINITIONS (12 badges), storage CRUD, useBadges hook with trackProgress/checkBadges, BadgePanel component with category-grouped grid, BadgeUnlockToast component. Total: 404/404 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-003-iter-005: Leaderboard — LeaderboardCategory/LeaderboardTimeFilter/LeaderboardEntry types, useLeaderboard hook with pure getLeaderboardEntries function, Leaderboard component with category tabs, time filter pills, top-3 medal styling, empty state. Total: 429/429 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-004-iter-001: Mobile responsive: Header flex-wrap, Trophy/Award icon-only on lg, title text-base md:text-lg, PracticeCard overflow-x-auto, input min-w-[60px], audio h-8 md:h-10. Extended App.responsive.test.tsx. Total: 434/434 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-004-iter-002: Mode-specific hints, 3-section wrong-answer feedback card, choice option icons (CheckCircle2/Circle), reorder progress text. Created App.hints.test.tsx + PracticeCard.feedback.test.tsx, extended choice/reorder tests. Total: 451/451 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-004-iter-003: isDefinitionSentence helper, ChoiceOption interface, definition sentence options in Chinese, sentence-reorder definition sentence handling. Total: 459/459 tests pass.
implementationStatus.epic-004-iter-004: Added REVIEW_INTERVALS constant [1,3,7,14] to types.ts, updated storage.ts scheduleNextReview to use it. Added rule explanation banner to SmartReview.tsx (visible when totalDue > 0). Created getPriorityLabel helper with 3 priority levels. New SmartReview.rules.test.tsx with 8 tests, updated SmartReview.test.tsx with priority badge test. Total: 468/468 tests pass.
